CommunityApplications.Profile:
Vitals is an AI-powered analytics and control center for Unraid. Beyond deep metrics — CPU, memory, network and temperature history, a full array table with per-disk fill/temperature/errors, a Docker and VM breakdown, SMART health with reallocated/pending sector counts, and auto-detected GPU/UPS panels — Vitals runs a team of specialist AI agents in the background (disk health, thermal, storage pools, network, general system health) that read your real metrics and logs, reason about them with an LLM, and write plain-English findings and recommendations straight to the dashboard. By default that analysis runs against the developer's own remote Ollama-compatible endpoints (your metrics and logs leave your network to reach them) — set LLM_STUDIO_PRIMARY and/or LLM_STUDIO_BACKUP in the plugin's Settings page (or directly in vitals.cfg on flash) to point the agents at your own local Ollama-compatible endpoint instead, and nothing leaves your network. The metrics dashboard, history, and controls never depend on the AI layer either way.
Vitals also gives you control, not just observation: restart or stop Docker containers, start/stop/restart VMs, and generate AI-written share descriptions from a share's actual contents — all from the same page, with Unraid's own CSRF protection and a confirm step before anything destructive happens.
Every finding the agents produce feeds a growing local knowledge base you can search, and a background "research" mode lets you ask an open-ended question about your server and get a considered answer later, using your own data against whichever LLM endpoint you've configured (see above) — no cloud account or subscription required.
Everything is collected locally every minute by a shell-and-PHP collector that reads Unraid's own state files. History lives in a 24-hour RAM ring buffer plus hourly rollups on the flash drive. The AI layer runs as a separate background process (Node.js + SQLite) that never blocks the dashboard — if it's off or the LLM endpoint is unreachable, the metrics dashboard and controls work exactly as before.
The stock dashboard is never modified — Vitals adds a page, a tile you can place wherever you like, and an optional "make it my start page" switch.
